Name: }bedrock.git.init

Parameters.Name: pConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it. If blank, the session.start default connection is used

Parameters.Name: pGitURL
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Git repository URL, e.g. https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>

Parameters.Name: pDeployment
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Deployment name from the .tm1project file

Parameters.Name: pUsername
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Git user name for HTTPS authentication

Parameters.Name: pPassword
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Git password or personal access token for HTTPS authentication. Never save a real value as the default

Parameters.Name: pPublicKey
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: SSH public key for SSH authentication

Parameters.Name: pPrivateKey
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: SSH private key for SSH authentication. Never save a real value as the default

Parameters.Name: pPassphrase
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Passphrase for the SSH private key

Parameters.Name: pForce
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Replace any existing Git context on the database (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
